title: P1: Make Finish archive-ready documentation alignment truthful
outOfScope: Release-only source-bound assessment semantics and release publication workflows.
Unrelated active or archived Work Items, including #634 and #638 implementation state.
Provider-side push, PR, merge, tag, release, or branch-deletion operations.

sources.reason: Authoritative P1 finding and required correction for completed Outcome/archive inconsistency.
Finish ordering, Outcome generation, blocked recovery, and archive invocation implementation.
Authoritative documentation-alignment validator and source-surface semantics.
Archive validates the active Summary and is the lifecycle consumer that previously exposed the defect.

riskAssessment.reason: A false completed Outcome can enable invalid lifecycle claims; corrective ordering must preserve truthful blocked recovery and archive fail-closed behavior.

reasons: Lifecycle and evidence-integrity corrective requires the standard governed profile.

executionDecision.reason: The Issue, current Finish/archive implementation, and deterministic regression tests provide sufficient bounded evidence.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Finish validates documentationAlignment before it can persist or report a completed Outcome; an incomplete alignment produces a valid blocked Outcome with failed gate and recovery condition.
The validation also runs after generated Outcome/report artifacts update the active Summary, so an archive-required documentation surface cannot make a completed Outcome stale.

Regression tests cover Japanese bound documentation evidence drift (Makefile, capability matrix, and test surfaces), completed-versus-blocked Outcome state, archive non-invocation on failed Finish, and successful retry/archive ordering.
Capability and pre-release documentation-alignment references state the corrected Finish/archive boundary without claiming release-only reassessment for ordinary Work Items.
guidelines: Keep lifecycle truth fail-closed: no completed Outcome may remain after a required archive-readiness condition fails.
Preserve deterministic, repository-relative documentation evidence validation and do not bypass generated report ownership.
Keep release-only source-bound assessment controls separate from ordinary Work Item Finish validation.

intent.problem: #623 demonstrated that ai-finish could emit an active completed Outcome and only later discover that documentation alignment made archive impossible. That creates contradictory lifecycle truth and repeats the Outcome reliability finding.
constraints: Start from latest origin/main and do not copy uncommitted #634 or #638 changes.
Use the existing canonical validator and generated Summary/report pathways; do not hand-edit generated reports to make a gate pass.
Keep blocked Outcomes durable and retryable, and do not weaken archive validation or release-only assessment controls.
Do not push, open a PR, merge, tag, or publish from this Work Item.
intent.rationale: Move archive-required documentation readiness into Finish before completion is claimed, then revalidate after generated artifacts alter evidence so a completed Outcome is a truthful prerequisite for archive.

rawUserRequest: Correct #626 completely: archive-required documentation alignment must not allow completed Outcome, including Japanese evidence drift and retry/archive order, using an independent governed Work Item.

declaredIntent.summary: Correct the archive-readiness/Outcome ordering defect without weakening release-only or archive controls.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused Finish integration test using an incomplete active Summary.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Outcome/report-generated Markdown surfaces are rechecked before completion; drift produces blocked rather than completed state.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused Finish integration test that makes post-generation alignment invalid.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Makefile, capability matrix, Japanese pre-release documents, and test files remain declared and bound in alignment evidence when changed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Validator regression test with the Japanese bound evidence set.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A repaired alignment permits completed Outcome followed by archive in canonical order.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Existing and new local Finish/archive E2E coverage plus ai-finish --archive local closure.
